node.title: AI Transformation — measure and scale AI adoption with ROI
node.summary: Measures the productivity impact and ROI of AI coding tools with causal analysis, cohort/A-B tests, CFO-ready reports, and the GAINS maturity roadmap.
node.interview_question: What exactly is the 'causal analysis' here — and can you defend it without naming an estimator you haven't published?

competitor.name: Jellyfish
competitor.positioning: Jellyfish ships an 'AI Impact' report today — but openly calls it correlation, which is the contrast Faros leans on; the risk is buyers can't tell the two apart on a slide.
